relationships.evidence_quote: atogepant's unexpected inhibitory effects on the C fibres may be mediated by its ability to bind to the AMY1 receptor

key_findings: Atogepant prevented CSD-induced activation and sensitization of HT neurons (1/10 vs 8/10 activated) but not activation of WDR neurons (5/10 vs 7/10).
Atogepant nonetheless prevented central sensitization of WDR neurons, unlike fremanezumab.
